title: Doesn't get warm enough
text: Doesn't get warm enough. I order the blue with pink/red swirls. Mine doesn't even get warm enough to completely melt all wax. Half the dish will have a melted pool a wax, but the other half will barely be melted. So needleless to say, this warmer doesn't throw a scent well. I've tried it with several different brands too (both commercial and independent brands)
